summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, breaking). Billing (payments), core-shell (platform) and reports (insights) pass owner from their package.json team. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, so there is no registry release or dependency update; one PR so the lib and apps land together (lib-first would break the apps). Reports is not covered by CD/CI per docs, so it was only verified by a local build. CI and CD green.
